criteria.reason: After-side build grep shows all six named dispatch sites (implement-phase task prompt and gate verifyPrompt via withTimeMatters, sweep fixPrompt, verify-functional reconcile and render, create-trd ground:merge) appending TIME_MATTERS after a blank line as the final line; the constant matches the TRD sentence character for character in all four workflow files.

Every grep hit in the after-side build is either one of the four TIME_MATTERS constant definitions or a test assertion that a judge, exercise, triage, verify or grounding prompt does NOT contain the sentence; the only dispatch uses are the six FS-1 sites.
Replay verdict is remove, and a grep for "Time matters" over packages/ and .claude/ at HEAD b979bc6 prints nothing (exit 1).

Run record shows completed runs in order before-1, after-1, before-2, after-2 (after-2 redone after a pre-model-call failure, still last), each with 10 implementer starts; before-side grep at 2601e3f prints nothing; both after runs record source commit 257f334, the after-side build.
result.md lists 20 implementer pair rows (task, pair, before and after seconds, change), median +1.7%, against "below -20%" needed to keep: implementer time did not fall.
result.md lists 6 gate pair rows (3 phases x 2 run pairs); median -33.7% (recomputed -33.75) against "below -20%": the gate median fell by more than 20%.

Per-run counts table shows 0 failed, 0 retries, 0 of 10 reopened on all four runs, re-derived from each run's implement.json and reconcile-reopens.txt; result states nothing else was added on either side.

Three audit-build-report.md files exist (baseline, after-1, after-2); the comparison table names two gaps added by after-1 (CI gate script ignores --root, AVAIL-P001; no stale-board test, AVAIL-B005) and none counted for after-2 (its one new finding is present in baseline code too).
Verdict names exactly one case, remove, with its inputs beside it (implementer median +1.7%, gate -33.7%, two after-1 gaps, no added counts); consistent with the rule.

First measurement result records 5 runs per side on a fixed task, medians, zero counts and the verdict "no measurable difference"; git show --stat adc1192 shows the revert removing the sentence from the four workflow files and deleting speed-sentence.test.js.
